name: HarmonyTavern rounded reading icons
preamble: Quiet, rounded front-facing line icons for the existing reading, storytelling and glass-control interface.

palette.runtime: Existing uiColors accent, textPrimary, textSecondary, textTertiary, textInverse and danger, applied through iconTint. Palette and dark-mode selection remain owned by Appearance.

construction.grid: 24 by 24, optical live area approximately 20 by 20
construction.angles: Orthogonal geometry and 45-degree diagonals, with rounded curves
construction.corner_radius: Soft 2-4 unit corners, scaled to the enclosing shape
construction.detail_budget: One concrete feature metaphor, at most three small internal details
construction.shared_parts: Shared plus, chevron, page, speech bubble and rounded frame geometry
construction.motif: Rounded book and speech frames, with a four-point story spark where semantically appropriate
construction.weight_hierarchy: The consistent outline is the defining element; no heavy filled shapes
construction.color_rule: One semantic runtime tint per icon; no baked theme background

adaptation: The skill reserves dense functional UI for vectors. These icons extend the existing SVG system directly; no raster generation or slicing is used.
